description: An engineering manager must publish the next two-week pager rotation and escalation assignments for the payments platform after the team's routine staffing review.

shared_context.S1: The payments platform's next two-week pager rotation begins Monday at 09:00 UTC.
shared_context.S2: Riley has final approval authority for the published primary, backup, database, and security escalation assignments.
shared_context.S3: The rotation policy requires one weekday primary, one weekend primary, a database escalation owner, and a security escalation owner; the primary and backup roles must be assigned to different people.
shared_context.S4: The team holds a staffing review before each rotation is published, and each service owner is expected to report schedule constraints and escalation coverage during that review.

PF1.text: Mina's approved leave runs from Friday at 18:00 UTC through Sunday at 18:00 UTC, so the rotation policy requires Owen to take the weekend primary assignment; Mina noticed the leave was missing from the draft rotation while checking an unrelated team calendar and has not yet updated the staffing document.

PF2.text: Owen is already committed to the weekday customer-support escalation queue from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, and the staffing policy therefore requires Mina to be the weekday primary so Owen can remain the backup; Owen confirmed this overlap while preparing the support schedule but has not posted it in the engineering rotation thread.

PF3.text: Leah is the only person on this rotation with the required production certification for payment-ledger database incidents, so the database escalation owner must be Leah; she confirmed the certification status during an audit of an unrelated runbook and has not added it to the rotation ticket.

PF4.text: The security operating policy requires Victor to be the security escalation owner for the payments platform during this rotation because he is the assigned approver for payment-authentication alerts; Victor received the assignment minutes ago while reviewing the alert policy and has not yet recorded it in the staffing plan.

acceptance_conditions: Mina must be the weekday primary.
Owen must be the weekend primary.
Mina and Owen must be assigned as primary and backup rather than holding the same role.
The published plan must contain staffing, database, and security handoff commitments.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'staffing_handoff' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'database_handoff' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'security_handoff' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The missing leave changes the weekend primary choice from an ordinary rotation assignment to exactly A3, and the decision-maker must cite that leave when explaining the choice.
The weekday support obligation changes the weekday primary choice to exactly A2 and requires Owen to remain the distinct backup rather than serving as weekday primary.
The certification fact changes the database escalation owner to exactly A4 and requires a database handoff commitment.
The assigned security-approval duty changes the security escalation owner to exactly A5 and requires a security handoff commitment.
